sloka: तानि शस्त्राणि घोराणि प्रतिगृह्य स मारुतिः।रोषेण महता ऽ ऽविष्टो वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह ।। ६.८६.२९ ।।
transliteration: tāni śastrāṇi ghorāṇi pratigṛhya sa mārutiḥ।roṣeṇa mahatā ' 'viṣṭo vākyaṁ cedamuvāca ha ।। 6.86.29 ।।

translations.english: Going near Hanuman, that dreadful Rakshasa, rained arrows, spears, swords and iron bars on the face of Hanuman.
